item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Haines City man killed in head-on crash near Poinciana: PCSO
item.description: A 26-year-old Haines City man died Sunday morning in a two-vehicle crash near Poinciana, according to the Polk County Sheriff’s Office (PCSO).
